title: Gravel Adventure Field Guide Releases its New York Guidebook
content:
Gravel Adventure Field Guide just announced its New York Guidebook. The Hudson Valley in New York is one of the most storied regions in the United States. What makes Ulster County a special gravel destination is a blend of rich American history, a pioneering art and environmental movement, a high-quality culinary scene, and dramatic natural landscapes. Plus, it’s located only 90 miles north of New York City. This Ulster County / Hudson Valley Gravel Adventure Field Guide highlights the communities of Kingston, New Paltz, and Woodstock…

A strong foundation and legacy around environmental conservation set the stage for Ulster County to offer some of the most exceptional and diverse gravel riding on the East Coast. The combination of rail trails, historic carriage roads, along with old wood roads and trails, accommodates all types of gravel riding. With over 600 miles of riding, the Ulster County Gravel Adventure Field Guide has something for old roadies or mountain bikers to appreciate.

Highlighting this Ulster County edition are routes that traverse the Shawangunk and Catskill Mountains. Riding out of the community of New Paltz, cyclists access the premier car-less gravel riding on Mohonk Preserve, Minnewaska State Park, and Mohonk House. Meanwhile, the Catskill Mountains offer up some challenging, yet rewarding, adventure riding options. An argument can be made that the Hudson Valley is the Shangri-La of East Coast gravel riding.

The close proximity to New York City and several major East Coast cities makes the Hudson Valley easily accessible for all gravel enthusiasts to explore. Grab a copy of the first Gravel Adventure Field Guide to discover all the great gravel routes and local insights to do an Ulster County visit right.

You can find the Ulster County-Catskills / Hudson Valley New York Gravel Adventure Field Guide at select bike shops listed on the Get One page. If residing outside the distribution zone, you can order one online.
